p.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.

ja: をほめたたえよ！ 私の
en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
u.src: 1  Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.

ja: 146:1 ヘブル語ではיה（ヤハ）である。
en:
146:1 Hebrew: יה Yah
146:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

en: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
u.src: 2  While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

p.src: 3  Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

en: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.
u.src: 3  Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

p.src: 4  His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

ja: その霊が去ると、その人は
る。 その日、その人の計画は
en: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
u.src: 4  His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

p.src: 5  Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,

en: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,
u.src: 5  Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,

p.src: 6  who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

ja: と、そこにあるすべてのものを
en: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
u.src: 6  who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

p.src: 7  who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.

en: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.
u.src: 7  who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.

p.src: 8  The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.

en: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.
u.src: 8  The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.

p.src: 9  The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

ja: り、 父のない者とやもめを
en: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
u.src: 9  The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

p.src: 10  The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!

ja: はとこしえに治められる。 シオンよ、あなたの
en: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
u.src: 10  The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!
